title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E6 — Brushfire
A canyon fire threatens the residents of a housing development and keeps the paramedics on round-the-clock duty; guest Tony Dow.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E7 — Dealer's Wild
DeSoto and Gage talk down an airplane flown by a teenage boy whose father, the pilot, suffered a heart attack while at the controls.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E8 — Nurses Wild
The paramedics hold a demonstration for student nurses, one of whom interests Gage; the hospital staff saves a robber and his victim.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E9 — Publicity Hound
Gage resents media attention given to a paramedic (Gary Crosby) from another squad; Brackett clashes with a tycoon over a diagnosis.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E13 — A Nice Place to Visit
While attending a friend's funeral, the A-Team encounters a crazed mountain clan. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E1 — Diamonds 'n' Dust
A mysterious woman (Kristen Meadows) wants her slain father's South African diamond mine freed from unscrupulous businessmen.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E2 — Recipe for Heavy Bread
The team members aid their former POW cook (Mako), an unwitting participant in drug smuggling; guest Marjoe Gortner.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E3 — The Only Church in Town
Face's former girlfriend (Markie Post), now a nun, hires the team to rescue nuns and orphans held in an Ecuadorean monastery.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E4 — Bad Time on the Border
A lost Mexican girl leads B.A. to a smuggling ring responsible for illegally transporting aliens across the border.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E5 — When You Comin' Back, Range Rider?
An Indian boy wants to stop a wealthy rancher (Morgan Woodward) rustling mustangs on an Arizona reservation.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E6 — When You Comin' Back, Range Rider?
The team attacks a trainload of mustangs headed for Mexico, only to have Hannibal and B.A. taken prisoner.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E7 — The Taxicab Wars
Hannibal poses as a rich Texan and his cohorts work as cabbies to save a struggling company from a ruthless competitor (Michael Ironside).

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E8 — Labor Pains
The team defends striking farmworkers from a corrupt grower paying starvation wages; guest Penny Peyser.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E9 — There's Always a Catch
An extortionist threatens a fisherman's livelihood. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.
